bundle.longDescription: Select text anywhere in Windows and Lumen offers a translation — the PopClip workflow from macOS, rebuilt natively. Free Google/Microsoft engines out of the box, plus OpenAI-compatible LLM providers.

infoPlist.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Lumen taps the audio of the app you choose to generate live subtitles. Audio is processed on-device and never uploaded.
